**Beckmann-X-Self-Improving-Proactive v1.1.0 Changelog**

- Added mandatory explicit user consent before any Beckmann insight is persisted to memory; all new insights start in a quarantine area.
- Enhanced memory integration: quarantine zone introduced, with no Beckmann data entering HOT/WARM/COLD tiers without user approval.
- Pinned dependencies to exact, audited versions with integrity (sha256) checks for improved security—auto-update is disallowed.
- SKILL.md and uninstall instructions now explicitly detail clean removal (optionally deleting all #beckmann entries).
- No functional changes to non-escalated, everyday tasks—default agent flow remains untouched.

File removed: `skill-card.md`

Initial release of the Beckmann × Self-Improving + Proactive Agent combination skill:

- Seamlessly connects the Self-Improving + Proactive Agent with the Beckmann Knowledge Graph for deep-reasoning escalation.
- Defines clear triggers for when to offer Beckmann analysis on complex or paradoxical questions, with user confirmation always required.
- Integrates Beckmann insights into tiered (HOT/WARM/COLD) proactive memory, following standard promotion/demotion rules.
- Ensures full independence: uninstalling this skill leaves both base skills intact.
- Provides detailed step-by-step escalation and memory integration protocols for structured, self-reflective answers on advanced problems.
